summary.en: The selected pipeline is weighted toward next-generation hematology and prostate-cancer immunotherapies, with additional immunology, depression and thrombosis programs. Collaborations are important across these platforms.
summary.zh: 所选管线重点为新一代血液肿瘤及前列腺癌免疫疗法，同时布局免疫、抑郁症和血栓预防；多个平台依托外部合作。

counts.note: As reported in the 13 October 2026 selected Innovative Medicine pipeline PDF: 93 programs. This historical snapshot is not rolled forward for subsequent approvals and is not a count of unique molecules.

watch.en: Milvexian is partnered with Bristol Myers Squibb and tau immunotherapy with AC Immune; development economics depend on individual agreements.

watch.en: Q3 reported EPS was $0.09 versus $2.59 adjusted, reflecting a proposed talc resolution charge and business-development transactions.
watch.zh: Q3 报告每股收益为0.09美元，调整后为2.59美元，差异涉及拟议滑石粉诉讼解决费用和业务拓展交易。

gaps: The dynamic investor pages exposed little table content, so the complete company-hosted October pipeline PDF was used. Its counts remain explicitly dated October 13 and can include programs subsequently approved.

Talquetamab is included only for its filed earlier-line combinations, not its existing later-line approval. November 10 still describes only its original approved label. No exact future regulatory action date was verified; next is null.

Origins of talquetamab, ramantamig, bleximenib, pasritamig, seltorexant and JNJ-4804 were not explicitly established; origin is null. Platform partnerships alone were not treated as proof of molecule origin.
Unverified development codes are null. Seltorexant mechanism is verified in the May 2024 company release, which predates 2026-06; its current stage uses October 2026.
No dated next milestone was verified for pasritamig, seltorexant, milvexian, JNJ-4804 or JNJ-2056; next is null.

The May 2026 JNJ-4804 mechanism release and March 2026 AC Immune filing predate 2026-06; stages are from October/November 2026. JNJ-2056 enrollment had been paused in February 2026; a restart was not verified, despite continued October pipeline listing.
Ramantamig is trispecific and maps to other in the restricted modality vocabulary; JNJ-4804 is a co-formulated pair of antibodies, not a single bispecific molecule.
